title: Reported questions & commands · 间接引语（疑问句与祈使句）
pattern: Subject + asked + if / whether + Subject + Verb  ·  Subject + told + Object + to + Verb
summary: 转述疑问句时用 if / whether 或疑问词加陈述语序；转述命令时用 tell / ask + 人 + to + 动词原形。
explanation: 转述**一般疑问句**（能用 yes 或 no 回答的问题）时，要用 if 或 whether 引导，后面改成**陈述语序**，句末不用问号：“Are you ready?” → She asked **if** I **was** ready.（她问我准备好了没有）。注意不能写成 asked if was I ready。
转述**特殊疑问句**时保留疑问词，同样改成陈述语序，时态也要后移：“Where do you live?” → He asked me **where** I **lived**. 中文的“问他住哪里”在英语里要把 where 放在前面，后面接陈述句。
转述**命令、请求和建议**时，用 tell 或 ask 加上人，再接 **to + 动词原形**；否定时在 to 前加 not：“Close the door.” → She told me **to close** the door. “Don't be late.” → He told us **not to be** late.
英语的动词选择比中文更严格：ask 常用于问题和请求，tell 常用于命令和指示。不能用 say 直接接人，例如 He said me to go. 是错误的，应该说 He told me to go.
时态与人称的变化和陈述句的间接引语相同：“Will you come?” → She asked whether I **would** come. 另外，whether 还可以与 or not 搭配，表示“是否”：I don't know whether he will come **or not**.
mistakes: ✗ She asked me where was I. → ✓ She asked me where I was. 间接问句要用陈述语序，主语要放在动词之前。
✗ He asked if did I know the answer. → ✓ He asked if I knew the answer. 转述时不保留 did，而是把动词改为过去式 knew。
✗ The teacher said me to sit down. → ✓ The teacher told me to sit down. 转述命令要用 tell + 人 + to，不能用 say + 人。
✗ She told me don't be late. → ✓ She told me not to be late. 否定的命令用 not to + 动词原形，而不是直接用 don't。

examples.text: She asked if I was ready.
examples.note: 一般疑问句：if + 陈述语序。

examples.text: He asked me where I lived.
examples.note: 特殊疑问句：保留疑问词 where。

examples.text: The teacher asked whether we had finished the exercise.
examples.translation: 老师问我们练习做完了没有。

examples.text: Mum told me to wash my hands before dinner.
examples.note: tell + 人 + to + 动词原形。

examples.text: The doctor told him not to eat too much salt.
examples.translation: 医生叫他不要吃太多盐。
examples.note: 否定命令：not to + 动词原形。

examples.text: I don't know whether she will come or not.
examples.note: whether ... or not 表示“是否”。

exercises.explanation: 问的是地点，应使用 where，后面接陈述语序 I lived。

exercises.sentence: The manager told us ___ late for the meeting.
exercises.translation: 经理叫我们开会不要迟到。
exercises.explanation: 转述否定命令要用 not to + 动词原形 be。

options: He asked me if I had been to Beijing.
He asked me if had I been to Beijing.
He asked if I have been to Beijing.
He asks me if I had been to Beijing.
exercises.explanation: 转述的疑问句用 if + 陈述语序，时态后移为 had been。

options: Dad told me to clean my room.
He said me to wait outside.
exercises.explanation: say 后面不能直接接人，应改为 He told me to wait outside。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 老师问我们是否听懂了。
exercises.explanation: whether 引导的间接问句使用陈述语序 we understood。

exercises.sentence: Tom asked his sister ___ she had seen his phone.
exercises.translation: 汤姆问他妹妹有没有看到他的手机。
exercises.explanation: 一般疑问句的转述使用 if，后面接陈述语序。

exercises.sentence: The nurse told the patient ___ the medicine twice a day.
exercises.translation: 护士叫病人每天吃两次药。
exercises.explanation: tell + 人 + to + 动词原形 take。

exercises.source: 妈妈叫我把房间收拾干净。
options: Mum told me to clean my room.
Mum said me clean my room.
Mum asked me clean my room.
Mum told me cleaning my room.
exercises.explanation: 转述命令用 told me to clean，ask 后面不能直接跟不带 to 的动词。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 她问我作业做完了没有。
exercises.explanation: if 引导的间接问句中，主语 I 在助动词 had 之后，使用陈述语序。
